name: CV Builder
context:
CV Builder is a project I developed to address a very common need among students and young professionals: quickly creating a clear and professional resume.

Many people want to apply for jobs but don’t always know how to structure their CV or use complex design tools.

The idea behind the project was to provide a simple and accessible tool to generate a professional CV directly from a web interface.
problem:
Creating a professional CV can be challenging for many candidates.

Traditional tools like text editors often require layout skills to achieve a clean and structured result.

Additionally, modifying or adapting a CV for different applications can quickly become tedious.

This complexity can slow down candidates in their job search process.
solution:
CV Builder provides a web application that allows users to create and generate a CV in just a few simple steps.

The user fills in different sections such as personal information, work experience, skills, and education.

The application then automatically structures this data into a clear and professional CV template.

The CV can then be easily exported for use in job applications.

architecture.structure:
The application is based on an architecture that separates the frontend and backend.

The frontend, built with Vue.js and Vuetify, provides an interactive interface allowing users to input their information and preview their CV in real time.

The backend, developed with Laravel, handles user data storage as well as CV generation and export.

This architecture makes it easy to add new CV templates and features in the future.

technicalChallenges: Designing a flexible system capable of handling different CV sections (experience, education, skills, etc.).
Implementing a dynamic preview that allows users to see their CV being built in real time.
Generating an exportable document while maintaining a clean and professional layout.
Ensuring a simple and intuitive interface to make the tool accessible even to non-technical users.
result:
The CV Builder project allows users to quickly create a structured and professional resume without having to manage layout themselves.

The tool simplifies CV creation and editing, enabling candidates to focus on content rather than formatting.

It provides a practical solution for efficiently preparing job applications.
